description: Manages system-level administrative tasks, primarily focused on database maintenance and schema updates.

endpoints.name: RunMigrations
endpoints.description: Initiates the execution of pending database migrations to update the system's data schema. This operation ensures the database structure is up-to-date with the latest application version.
example_uses: Run the latest database migrations for the system.
Update the system's database schema to the newest version.
Execute any pending database changes required by the application.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to manually trigger database schema updates, typically after a new application deployment or when database changes are required to be applied to align with the current application code.
